_comment: Supervision values per harness, used by the builders of E2 to E13. bounded_wait_s and progress_s come from V1 (measurements.adoc, transport limits). ack, ack_deadline_s, silence_grace_s, idle_wakeups and token_budget are provisional until E1 (ack variant and deadline) and E2 (silence grace) are measured; the measured values replace them here and are recorded in task-protocol.adoc.
